state.paragraph: At a meeting on June 18, 2014, the board reviewed, together with a financial advisor and with Wachtell, Lipton, Rosen & Katz ("Wachtell Lipton"), its legal advisor, the various strategic and financial alternatives potentially available to the Company and determined to explore more intensively potential changes to the Company's capital structure, with a focus on returning capital to stockholders. The board also established an ad hoc advisory subcommittee (the "ad hoc committee") with respect to, among other
